basic_info.description: Contemporary design meets Victorian character at 145 Buchanan, a top-floor, full-floor flat with abundant natural light, striking views, and generous scale. Upon entry, an expansive living room with 11-foot ceilings and a classic fireplace delivers the scale for multiple seating areas and entertaining. The spacious formal dining room is anchored by a chic marble fireplace and luxurious finishes. With views stretching from Twin Peaks to Buena Vista Park, the kitchen is equipped with Carrara marble counters, Viking range, built-in refrigerator with double freezer drawers, and a Bosch dishwasher. Two bedrooms and two full baths are set apart from the public rooms. The primary suite offers stunning views and is fully remodeled in Porcelanosa fixtures. In-unit laundry and storage is abundant with five closets and a private, secure storage room. Upgrades include hardwood floors throughout, skim-coated plaster walls, designer lighting, and a SAVANT smart-home media and security system. Independent garage parking with interior access, and a shared back patio complete the offering. With quick access to 101, and steps to Whole Foods, Duboce park, gyms, salons, and the dining scenes of Haight and Hayes Valley.
